title: Determination of toxic comments and unintended model bias minimization using Deep learning approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity classification parity by computing Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics on comments mentioning gender identity terms (e.g., male, female, transgender) to measure false positive and false negative disparities.

Evaluating toxicity classification parity by computing Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics on comments mentioning sexual orientation terms (e.g., homosexual, gay, lesbian) to measure false positive and false negative disparities.

Evaluating toxicity classification parity by computing Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics on comments mentioning religious identity terms (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish) to measure false positive and false negative disparities.

Evaluating toxicity classification parity by computing Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics on comments mentioning racial identity terms (e.g., black, white, Asian, Latino) to measure false positive and false negative disparities.

Evaluating toxicity classification parity by computing Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics on comments mentioning disability terms (e.g., psychiatric or mental illness, physical disability) to measure false positive and false negative disparities.
